effect.description.alchimiae.feast: An instant effect that fills hunger
effect.description.alchimiae.famine: An instant effect that makes one hungrier
effect.description.alchimiae.immune: An effect which makes harmful effects go away sooner
effect.description.alchimiae.afflicted: An effect which makes beneficial effects go away sooner
effect.description.alchimiae.stride: An effect that makes one step higher and faster
effect.description.alchimiae.fuse: An interesting effect, that, should it expire, causes one to violently explode
effect.description.alchimiae.cleanse: An instant effect that may remove some negative effects
effect.description.alchimiae.muck: An instant effect that may remove some positive effects
effect.description.alchimiae.diminish: An instant effect which shortens the duration of all other effects
effect.description.alchimiae.extend: An instant effect which extends the duration of all other effects
effect.description.alchimiae.leyden: An effect that makes one heavier
effect.description.alchimiae.fickle: A bizarre effect which will become another effect once consumed
effect.description.alchimiae.arachnid: This effect allows one to scale walls like a spider
effect.description.alchimiae.chrysopic: This effect lets one glide, almost as if they were wearing an elytra
effect.description.alchimiae.dire_fall: An effect which causes one to take massive damage from small falls
command.alchimiae.reset_desc: Resets all alchimiae data in this world.
command.alchimiae.reset_desc_2: Existing potions and mash will remain, but all effects will be reset and forgotten.
command.alchimiae.reset: Alchimiae data have been reset for this world.
command.alchimiae.reset_player: You have forgotten your alchemical knowledge.
info.alchimiae.grinder_1: Grinders can be used to combine Ingredients into Mash.
info.alchimiae.grinder_2: Just craft multiple items marked as "Ingredient" with a Grinder or Mortar and Pestle.
info.alchimiae.mash_1: Mash can be turned into potions through a couple of methods.
info.alchimiae.mash_2: The simplest of these is crafting them with a bottle of water, which makes one potion.
info.alchimiae.mash_3: You can also place them into the top slot of a Brewing Stand, though their duration will be reduced.
